_: The state a correct replay of conformance/revision-2.4/library.roost produces. Normative; see ../README.md. Required of an implementation stating revision 2.4 or later (RL-54).
_assets: Both carried wood, written in two cases. `tag_delete` names it in a third, and takes it off both: names compare case-insensitively. The tag added again afterwards is a new tag, and is in no group.
_tags_in_use: Whether a tag with no assets survives is open (FORMAT.md §11.4), so only the tags carried are asserted. Deleting `never-was` is a no-op and is not dangling: a tag is named, never numbered.
